items.text: Surround, for headsets such as Apple Vision Pro: the grid and field on a curved wall all around you, and a pinch works as a touch. The button appears in the bar only where the browser offers it. The room does not show through: Safari on Vision Pro does not allow that to web pages, so it replaces the room. Not yet tried on a headset.
changed: On a phone held upright, and on a wide screen, undo and redo now sit before the record group, so the full-screen button is the last one in the bar, in the corner where play view keeps it.

fixed: Clean screen was hard to leave. Tap anywhere outside the grid (on a phone, the black strip under it) or press Esc and the controls come back; playing the grid does not leave it. That tap no longer presses whatever button appears under your finger.

Saving a video is clearer. The camera panel now has a Video length (15, 30 or 60 seconds, or tap stop), counts in 3, 2, 1 so the first second is not lost, shows the time left while recording, and stops by itself. Its hint says to start the music first.

changed: Plain words. The camera is "Save a video, picture or GIF", the export tray is "Save the notes" (MIDI, score or moves, not a video), and the red circle says it records your hand moves as a loop, not a video.

Clean screen (the eye with a slash in the record group) hides every control and leaves only the grid and field, for a mirrored phone or iPad screen. A web page cannot tell that a screen is mirrored, so you switch it on; tap the bottom right corner or press Esc to bring the controls back. Playing the grid still works while it is clean.

Presentation window (desktop, the monitor icon): opens a second window with only the grid and field. In Chrome with a second screen it opens there, and a double-click makes it full screen; your controls stay on your own screen. Sound still plays from the first window.

Auto dice has two more options, Shuffle locks and Wander weave. Each automatic roll can first lock a few random rows and columns (so a little of the last scene carries on, never everything) and pick a weave preset or none. Turn the robot and auto dice on, go to play view, and it composes on its own.
In the play view, holding the robot opens a slim vertical list of the line-ups instead of the whole heads-up display, with a close button. The heads-up display also has a close button now.
changed: The return icon stays in exactly the same place when the play view settles into full screen.

changed: Three views now: the regular view, the play view (the button in the record group) and the full screen (a few quiet seconds later, only the grid and the return icon). The play view saves the side gutters so the grid is as wide as the screen allows, the return icon sits on the same row as the bottom bars, and the tempo bar stretches across the free width.
changed: When the phone zooms the grid, the grid lines stay as thin as before; only the marks get bigger.
changed: The stay-awake icon in the top right no longer shows in full screen.

changed: Full screen is now the last button in its group (export moved in front of it). Pressing it makes it fly to the lower right corner and pulse. The right menu, the duck-rabbit and undo/redo slip away, the score grows, and the scene, record and tempo controls stay low. After a few quiet seconds only the full-screen icon is left; tap it, or the strip where the controls were, to bring them back. Tap it again to leave full screen.
